description: This source file defines an actor named RemoteTunnelManager responsible for managing SSH tunnels for remote gateway/control ports in a macOS application. It includes methods to ensure a tunnel is active, reuse existing tunnels, and handle restarts with backoff logic.

classes.name: RemoteTunnelManager
classes.description: An actor that manages SSH tunnels for remote gateway/control port forwarding, ensuring they are active and handling restarts with backoff logic.

methods.name: controlTunnelPortIfRunning
methods.description: Checks if an existing SSH tunnel is active and listening; if not, attempts to reuse a previous tunnel or returns nil.

methods.name: ensureControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures an SSH tunnel is established for the control port, creating a new tunnel if necessary.

methods.name: isSshProcess
methods.description: Determines if a given port descriptor corresponds to an SSH process.

methods.name: beginRestart
methods.description: Initiates a restart of the SSH tunnel with a backoff delay.

methods.name: endRestart
methods.description: Marks the end of a restart process.

methods.name: waitForRestartBackoffIfNeeded
methods.description: Implements backoff delay logic before attempting to restart the tunnel.
